t: This is the St Pancras Railway Station Workers War Memorial, a war memorial in London. It remembers the railway station workers who were lost in war. The memorial was made by Fabian Peake, who was born in 1942, and his hand is what you see in the work. Memorials like this one are a quiet way of keeping the names and sacrifices of ordinary working people in view. Take a moment here, and look for any inscription that tells you more about those it honours.
